an8.62:1.1: Chahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano alaṃ paresaṃ.
an8.62:1.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu,
an8.62:1.6: attham aññāya dhammam aññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno ca hoti,
an8.62:1.7: kalyāṇavāco ca hoti kalyāṇavākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagaḷāya atthassa viññāpaniyā,
an8.62:1.8: sandassako ca hoti samādapako samuttejako sampahaṃsako sabrahmacārīnaṃ.
an8.62:1.9: Imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano alaṃ paresaṃ. 3.
an8.62:2.1: Pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi sammannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano alaṃ paresaṃ.
an8.62:2.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu na h' eva kho khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu,
an8.62:2.6: attham aññāya dhammam aññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno ca hoti,
an8.62:2.7: kalyāṇavāco ca hoti . . . pe . . . atthassa viññāpaniyā,
an8.62:2.8: sandassako ca hoti samādapako samuttejako sampahaṃsako sabrahmacārīnaṃ
an8.62:2.9: Imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano alaṃ paresaṃ. 5.
an8.62:3.1: Catūhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano no paresaṃ.
an8.62:3.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu,
an8.62:3.6: attham aññāya dhammam aññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno ca hoti,
an8.62:3.7: no ca kalyāṇavāco hoti kalyāṇavākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagaḷāya atthassa viññāpaniyā,
an8.62:3.8: no ca sandassako hoti samādapako samuttejako sampahaṃsako sabrahmacārīnaṃ.
an8.62:3.9: Imehi kho bhikkhave catūhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano no paresaṃ. 7.
